items.summary:
## Problem
An issue often contains two different things: what's wrong, or what's wanted (the outcome), and how the author thinks it should be fixed (a proposed change). The contract treats every sentence as a binding requirement, and narrowing a requirement fails conformance. A proposed fix therefore becomes mandatory. A lane must build the author's guess even when its own investigation finds a better fix, and it is blocked if it deviates.

items.title: GenerateWithTools drops tool_use input: ToolUse.Input is always nil
items.summary:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Found while implementing #4 (PR #33).

`anthropicContentBlock.Input` is tagged `json:"-"` so that `MarshalJSON` can always send `input` on outgoing `tool_use` blocks. The type has no `UnmarshalJSON`, so when an API response is decoded the `input` object of each `tool_use` block is dropped. `GenerateResponse.ToolUses[i].Input` is therefore always nil, for both `Generate` and `GenerateWithTools`.
